dialogues.speaker: Waaj
dialogues.text: (The Tatankasaurus seems to be grumbling under its breath...)

dialogues.speaker: Waaj
dialogues.text: Hmph, what do you have to show off about when you're still so weak...

dialogues.speaker: Waaj
dialogues.text: The only thing that deserves praise is hard work... Such foolishness...

dialogues.speaker: Waaj
dialogues.text: Hmph, what do you have to show off about when you're still so weak...

dialogues.speaker: Waaj
dialogues.text: You're lucky you weren't seriously injured... You know full well your skills aren't up to scratch, but you still go charging off at the head of the pack. What if something really serious happened...

dialogues.speaker: Waaj
dialogues.text: You should be focusing on training more. Train, train, train, that's the only remedy. Honestly, it's all such foolishness...
